judgements.justification: No reviewer or area chair in either committee raised audience breadth or venue fit.
B's area chair called the reviews 'overwhelmingly positive' despite eiQW's 4, but B's poster followed its 6.0 mean, not that wording; A's meta-review reports the unanimous acceptance correctly.
Neither committee had most reviewers silent: in A, imZu edited and C7hP replied; in B, only eiQW stayed silent, and no reviewer in either committee is known to have revised a score.
Only A's Reviewer_C7hP (7, math not checked) fits, and A's mean without it stays 7.0, so it did not lift A's mean or tier.
Neither committee split evenly: A was 6, 7, 7, 8 and B was 4, 7, 6, 7.
The authors gave both committees the same framing of SMI as a dependence measure; B's concessions answered issues only B raised, and the notes record no conflicting accounts.
The originality misreads (C7hP's 'new MI estimator', eiQW's 'standard DV estimation') misread the paper itself, not prior work, and are covered by R15.
A gave a spotlight at a 7.0 mean, where 32 of 44 copies got a poster, and its meta-review says only 'nice work' with potential broad impact, with no word on the tier.
No reviewer in either committee contested the paper's framing from a neighbouring field's premises; the SMI-as-MI-estimator reading was a misread, answered in both committees.
A's champion imZu (8, 3.5 h) gave a thin review, and B's positive reviewers GPCD and 6PJ4 (7 each) engaged after the rebuttal, so neither side had an engaged champion that the other lacked.
Both committees accepted; B made the DPI fix a camera-ready condition, and no one judged the promised fixes too large.
Both area chairs relied on the visible reviews; no off-record input is mentioned.

B's Reviewer_eiQW gave 4 for missing downstream benchmarks and estimator baselines on what the authors called 'primarily a theoretical work', while A's Reviewer_dcfo called such benchmarks 'probably out of scope'.
eiQW's 4 rests on missing baselines and proof-of-concept experiments, which are central to the paper's empirical case, and eiQW never engaged after the rebuttal.
